dedupe_keys.name: natural water retention measures nwrm platform eu catalogue of measures benefits tables and case studies

description: The Natural Water Retention Measures (NWRM) platform gathers information at EU level on measures that retain water within catchments and so support green infrastructure in the water sector, helping to achieve and maintain healthy water ecosystems with multiple benefits. It was set up under a DG Environment pilot project on integrating NWRM in river basin management and is maintained by the Office International de l'Eau. Coverage: European Union, with case studies from member states. The site offers the NWRM definition and related concepts, a catalogue of measures sorted by sector, starting with agriculture, benefits tables by measure, a practical implementation guide, synthesis documents, an illustrated PDF catalogue, and a catalogue of case studies that can be filtered by level of detail and by the measures applied, from afforestation of reservoir catchments and basins and ponds to floodplain restoration, green roofs and infiltration trenches. Format and access: HTML pages and PDF documents; users can submit new case studies; free. Licence: not open; the site is under French and international copyright, (c) NWRM 2013-2024. Caveats: information is general and not guaranteed complete or up to date, as the disclaimer says; case study depth varies. Simulation uses: measure types, benefits and documented examples for designing and costing nature-based flood and drought adaptation around water and transport infrastructure. Related records: the Altovicentino case study (case_study-altovicentino-natural-water-retention-measures) is one NWRM example already catalogued.
